data.action: 坐在地板标记旁喝水，看着镜中自己重新鼓劲。
data.description: 空排练室，她对着整墙镜子反复练习同一个转身，地板上是贴着标记的胶带；休息时直接坐在地板上喝水，看着镜中的自己，表情在不甘与鼓劲之间切换。
data.promptProse: Kana repeats a turn in the empty rehearsal room, charcoal T-shirt and burgundy track trousers aligned with tape marks on the floor. During a pause she sits down to drink water, watching her reflected face shift between frustration and resolve. The medium view includes the mirror and marked practice space. Studio lights reveal the tape edges and bottle, with soft floor shadows beneath her bent knees and white sneakers.
data.title: 有马加奈 · 排练室镜子前的独白
